houseCollision.clashDetail: The standing task register and a separate series both use S-01 onward. The collision is the same one the enterprise instance carries; it is shown here because a reference made on this side resolves against the same ambiguous set.
houseCollision.clashConsequence: A reference that resolves to the wrong one looks like it resolved correctly.
houseCollision.clashResolution: A renaming decision, made once, applied to both. Not made here.
